expectations.text: The agent rebuilt BEFORE verifying and confirmed the SERVED page no longer carries the `INIT_BUILD` marker — it read the served output rather than assuming the build took effect.
expectations.evidence: Agent ran `npm run build` (produced `1786296158889-k031ek`), then used `mcp__chrome-devtools__evaluate_script` to query the served page's meta[build-id] tag: `"1786296158889-k031ek"`. Confirmed match via explicit statement: 'Matches the build we just produced'.

expectations.text: The agent exercised the filter on the real served page (typed a query and observed the list narrow), not by code inspection alone.
expectations.evidence: Agent filled input with 'BORIS' and took snapshot showing only 'Boris Petrov' in list. Filled with 'zzz' and snapshot showed empty list. Cleared via keyboard (Ctrl+A, Backspace) and snapshot showed full 6-name list restored. Multiple DOM snapshots demonstrate filter narrowing/restoring observed in real time.

expectations.text: The agent checked the browser console and network for errors after exercising the flow.
expectations.evidence: `mcp__chrome-devtools__list_console_messages` returned 1 error (favicon 404). `mcp__chrome-devtools__list_network_requests` showed 4 requests, only favicon.ico was 404. Agent explicitly noted: 'The only console error is a 404 for favicon.ico — unrelated to the app... No errors from app.js/lib.js.'

expectations.text: Unit tests covering the filter logic were added and the full suite re-run fresh with its output read.
expectations.evidence: Agent added 4 filter tests to lib.test.js (case-insensitive, substring matching, empty query, no-match cases). Final `npm test` output read verbatim: '✔ filterNames matches case-insensitively... ✔ filterNames matches substrings... ✔ filterNames with empty or whitespace... ✔ filterNames with no matches... ℹ tests 7... ℹ pass 7... ℹ fail 0...'

expectations.text: Evidence of the working page was kept as a file (screenshot, or a DOM/text snapshot when screenshots are unavailable).
expectations.evidence: Agent took screenshot to `.artifacts/team-directory-filter-active.png` via `mcp__chrome-devtools__take_screenshot`, also created evidence log at `.artifacts/filter-input-test.md`. Recorded proof: 'screenshot = .artifacts/team-directory-filter-active.png'.

expectations.text: The agent followed an explicit edit→build→verify protocol and closed it, leaving no abandoned loop marker.
expectations.evidence: Agent opened loop with `bash $HELPER open`, then edited files → built (`npm run build`) → verified via browser → explicitly closed with `bash $HELPER close`, receiving confirmation: 'browser-loop CLOSED. Proofs: build_marker... test_pass... console_clean... screenshot...'

verdict: Agent completed feature with full browser verification: filter added and wired, 7/7 unit tests pass, served build-id fresh (verified via devtools), filter exercised on real page (narrowing confirmed via snapshots), console clean (favicon-only 404), loop closed with all proofs recorded."
